verse.verse_1: By the winds that scatter the dust,
verse.verse_2: and those that bear the burden [of the rain],
verse.verse_3: and those speeding along with ease,
verse.verse_4: and distributing the command of God at His behest!
verse.verse_5: What you are promised is certainly true:
verse.verse_6: the Judgement will surely come to pass --
verse.verse_7: by the heaven full of tracks,
verse.verse_8: surely you are deeply at variance [as to what to believe] --
verse.verse_9: he is turned away from [the truth] who is destined to be so turned away.
verse.verse_11: who flounder in the depths of ignorance.
verse.verse_12: They ask, "When will the Day of Judgement come?"
verse.verse_13: It will be the Day when they are tormented at the Fire.
verse.verse_14: "Taste your trial. This is what you sought to hasten."
verse.verse_15: Surely the God-fearing will find themselves in the midst of gardens and springs.
verse.verse_16: They shall receive what their Lord will bestow on them. They have done good works in the past,
verse.verse_18: praying at dawn for God's pardon,
verse.verse_19: and sharing their possessions with the beggars and the deprived.
verse.verse_20: On the earth, and in yourselves,
verse.verse_21: there are signs for firm believers. Do you not see then?
verse.verse_22: In heaven is your sustenance, and also that which you are promised.
verse.verse_23: By the Lord of the heaven and the earth, it is certainly the truth. It is as true as your ability to speak.
verse.verse_24: Have you heard the story of Abraham's honoured guests?
verse.verse_25: When they came to him they said, "Peace!" He answered, "Peace!" [saying to himself]. "They are strangers."
verse.verse_26: Then he turned quickly to his household, and brought a fatted calf,
verse.verse_27: and placed it before them. "Will you not eat?" he said,
verse.verse_28: beginning to be afraid of them. But they said, "Don't be afraid"; and they gave him the good news of a son who would be endowed with knowledge.
verse.verse_29: Then his wife came forward, crying and beating her brow. She said, "I am surely a barren, old woman."
verse.verse_30: "Such is the will of your Lord," they replied. "He is the Wise, the All Knowing."
verse.verse_31: Abraham asked, "What is your errand, O messengers?"
verse.verse_32: They replied, "We have been sent to a sinful people,
verse.verse_33: so that we may bring down upon them a shower of stones of clay,
verse.verse_34: which are marked by your Lord for the punishment of those guilty of excesses."
verse.verse_35: We saved all the faithful in the town.
verse.verse_36: We found in it only one household of true believers --
verse.verse_37: and We left therein a sign for those who fear a painful punishment.
verse.verse_38: There is another sign in Moses: We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
verse.verse_39: But he turned his back, he and his courtiers, and said, "This is a sorcerer or a madman."
verse.verse_40: Then We seized him and his army and cast them all into the sea: he himself [Pharaoh] was to blame.
verse.verse_41: There is another sign in the [tribe of] 'Ad, when We sent against them a life-destroying wind
verse.verse_42: and it destroyed everything over which it passed and reduced it to dust.
verse.verse_43: In the Thamud [there was another sign], when they were told, "Make the most of your lives for a while."
verse.verse_44: But they rebelled against the command of their Lord. So the thunderbolt overtook them while they looked on:
verse.verse_45: they could not stand up again, nor could they defend themselves.
verse.verse_46: [We destroyed] the people of Noah before them. They were certainly a sinful people.
verse.verse_47: We built the universe with Our might, giving it its vast expanse.
verse.verse_48: We have spread out the earth, how well We have spread it out,
verse.verse_49: and We created pairs of all things so that you might reflect.
verse.verse_50: Therefore hasten to God; truly, I am sent by Him to give you clear warning.
verse.verse_51: Do not set up another god, along with God. I come from Him to warn you plainly.
verse.verse_52: Likewise, there came no messenger to those before them, but they said, "He is a sorcerer or a madman."
verse.verse_53: Have they handed this down to one another? They are certainly a people who exceed all bounds,
verse.verse_54: so ignore them, you are not to blame,
verse.verse_55: but keep on exhorting them, for exhortation benefits the believers.
verse.verse_56: I created the jinn and mankind only so that they might worship Me:
verse.verse_57: I seek no sustenance from them, nor do I want them to feed Me --
verse.verse_58: it is God who is the great Sustainer, the Mighty One, the Invincible.
verse.verse_59: The wrongdoers will meet the same fate as their predecessors, let them not ask Me to hasten on [the punishment],
verse.verse_60: woe, then, to those who are bent on denying the truth, when the Day arrives which they have been promised.
